topPRs.title: eth/072: Ink Mainnet SystemConfig gas limit 60M to 30M
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Adds `src/tasks/eth/072-gas-limit-ink`: sets the Ink Mainnet (chainId 57073) `SystemConfig` gas limit from 60,000,000 back to 30,000,000 with a single `SystemConfig.setGasLimit(uint64)` call on the `SystemConfigProxy` `0x62C0a111929fA32ceC2F76aDba54C16aFb6E8364`, executed directly by its owner, the Foundation Upgrade Safe `0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92` (owner since eth/065). No other `SystemConfig` parameter changes.

Built with the `SystemConfigGasLimit` template, the same one used for eth/055 (OP Mainnet) and sep/103 (Ink Sepolia); the template roots the task at `SystemConfigOwner`, resolved per chain from `SystemConfig.owner()`. Docs follow the eth/067 and eth/071 layout: signer-only README sections, facilitator steps and state changes in VALIDATION.md.

Inputs: 30,000,000 is Ink's genesis gas limit (`superchain/configs/mainnet/ink.toml`, `genesis.system_config.gasLimit`) and the value Ink Sepolia runs with; the live Mainnet value is 60,000,000 (read 2026-09-21). The task is sequenced after eth/071, which consumes one FUS nonce as an L1PAO child, so the FUS nonce is pinned to 71 (live 70 + 1). `just simulate-stack eth 072-gas-limit-ink` runs 071 then 072 and exits 0 on this branch, which is rebased on #1554 (the post-U20 registry game discovery fix; without it the stacked run reverts with `zero address for PermissionedDisputeGame` after 071 upgrades Ink).

Status is DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN pending review; the hashes are fixed by the nonce pin and do not depend on 071's execution date.
